title: Helly selection for uniformly bounded nondecreasing functions with a countable exceptional set
statement: Let (F_j)_{j∈ℕ} be functions ℝ → ℝ, each nondecreasing, and let C ∈ ℝ with |F_j(t)| ≤ C for all j ∈ ℕ and t ∈ ℝ. Then there exist a strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ and a countable set E ⊆ ℝ such that for every s ∈ ℝ ∖ E and every ε > 0 there are real numbers a < s < b with F_{ψ(j)}(b) − F_{ψ(j)}(a) < ε for all sufficiently large j.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ j, Monotone (F j)) → (∀ j t, |F j t| ≤ C) → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (E : Set ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ E.Countable ∧ ∀ s ∉ E, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ a b : ℝ, a < s ∧ s < b ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, F (ψ j) b - F (ψ j) a < ε
